description: agent.changes is the agent ledger's window and the paging convention's second adopter (S73 AR6, docs/aeon/PAGING.md PG1–PG5): two keys in, `page` and `pageSize`, plus the optional `slug` that narrows the whole thing to one agent — and here it is absent, which asks for EVERYTHING. The answer is the window newest first, the two paging keys as the daemon applied them, `total` for the filtered set, and `slug` echoed so a caller can never be shown someone else's history by a routing bug. Row 0 is a person editing a card; row 1 is the upgrade's back-fill, whose `slug` is `null` — the one row AR1 lets carry no name, because a run that derived forty agents belongs to no single one of them and appears in nobody's history. Its nullability is on the wire, not in a comment: an app that typed `slug` non-null would break on exactly this row. No `sort`, no `dir`, no `q`: a history has one order, and a read refuses a key it cannot honour instead of accepting it and ignoring it.
